messages:
Maya: Morning — quick async sync: what I did / blockers / today

Maya: What I did: implemented header-based routing shim for 'lane-b' and added a fallback to lane-a. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/189

Maya: Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s in staging when traffic hits lane-b during bursts. Can't reproduce locally; staging logs show rate-limiter returning 429 with token_bucket mismatch.

Omar: Looking into it. Can you paste the routing policy snippet and confirm which rate-limiter version you're running? Also did you upgrade the redis lua scripts recently?

Maya: Snippet below:
```
route "lane-b" {
  match: header("x-traffic-lane") == "B"
  rate_limit { requests: 120 per_min }
  fallback: "lane-a"
}
```
Running RL v2.3.1 (same as staging cluster). No manual lua changes from me.

Luis: FYI ci-bot flagged a flaky e2e in the canary that times out at ~10s — might be related to header propagation or an extra hop.

Priya: Quick thought — check rate limiter shard_count. We had a config drift before where staging used shard_count=1 but prod uses 4; a single shard can hit bursts and trigger 429s under bursty traffic.

Omar: Good call. Maya, can you confirm chart values for staging? If it's 1, change to 4 and redeploy canary.

Maya: Confirmed: staging chart had shard_count: 1. Pushing chart change to set shard_count: 4 and redeploying canary now. Will paste deploy id.

ci-bot: deploy started for maya/routing-lane-chart (canary) — id: dpl_20260317_1142

Maya: Redeploy done. Initial canary traffic looks cleaner in logs, 429 rate dropped to near zero. Will monitor for 30 minutes then consider promoting.

Priya: If 429s persist post-shard fix, fallback plan is to flip a temporary edge toggle to route affected customers to lane-a (header override) while we root cause.

Luis: I'll open a small console PR to expose the header toggle in admin so SREs can flip it fast if needed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/512

Maya: Thanks — for now blocker mitigated. I'll keep an eye and post follow-up.

Omar: Thanks everyone. I'll add a follow-up ticket to ops board to ensure shard_count parity across envs (#OPS-724).

Maya: TL;DR: fixed staging shard_count -> redeployed canary, watching for 30m. Blocker mitigated.
